content:
Decimals arrive in Class 4 with tenths and hundredths — and Olympiad papers love decimal-fraction conversions and comparisons. Here is what the IMO Class 4 decimals chapter tests, the facts, the traps, and a free 10-question test with answers.

What the Class 4 Maths Olympiad Decimals chapter tests

  • Decimal place value (tenths and hundredths)
  • Fraction ↔ decimal conversion
  • Comparing and ordering decimals
  • Adding and subtracting decimals

Key facts your child should know

  • In 3.47: 4 is tenths (4/10) and 7 is hundredths (7/100).
  • 3/10 = 0.3; 45/100 = 0.45; 1/4 = 0.25; 1/2 = 0.5.
  • Padding zeros changes nothing: 0.5 = 0.50, so 0.5 > 0.45.
  • Line up the decimal points before adding or subtracting.

Common mistakes to avoid

  • Thinking 0.45 > 0.5 because 45 > 5.
  • Misaligning decimal points in a sum.
  • Writing 7/100 as 0.7 instead of 0.07.

quiz.title: IMO Class 4 Decimals Quiz
quiz.intro: Ten Olympiad-pattern questions. Pick an answer for each, then press Check my score.

questions.q: A carpenter joins a plank of 1.85 m with another of 2.35 m. How long is the joined plank?

questions.explanation: 5 hundredths = 0.05; a zero is needed in the tenths place.

questions.q: A square is divided into 100 equal parts and 45 parts are shaded. Which decimal shows the shaded part?
questions.explanation: 45 out of 100 equal parts means 45 hundredths = 0.45.

questions.q: In which place does the digit 5 sit in 61.58, and what is its value?
questions.explanation: 5 is the first digit after the decimal point, so it is in the tenths place with value 0.5.

questions.q: 3.5 is the same as how many tenths?
A notebook costs ₹24.50 and a pen costs ₹8.75. How much do they cost together?
What is the place value of 6 in 3.96?
questions.explanation: The 6 is in the hundredths place, so its value is 6 hundredths = 0.06.

questions.q: As a fraction, 0.3 is the same as ___.

faq.q: How do you compare two decimals?
faq.a: Compare the whole parts first, then tenths, then hundredths. Pad with zeros to the same length if it helps.
